paragraphs.text: Coram , also known as the Undertaker , is a human warrior from an unknown plane.

Coram is a character that was introduced in Modern Horizons 3 Commander as an alternate commander of the "Graveyard Overdrive" deck. He is a very large, muscular human male who wields a large metal shovel with blades on its side. Coram wears light cloth or leather armor adorned with various skulls, both animal and humanoid, and wears a mask over the lower half of his face. He gains power from the strongest creature in the graveyard, forces his opponents to mill when he attacks, and then allows the player to play one of the cards added to the graveyard from the library.
Kai Carpenter 's art for Coram, the Undertaker is labeled "Choratt, The Gravedigger", implying this was the character and card's original name.
